details: U.S. President Donald Trump is meeting with Chinese President Xi Jinping in Beijing for a two-day summit. Discussions are set to cover crucial issues including trade relations, the ongoing conflict with Iran, and the sensitive issue of U.S. arms sales to Taiwan. Xi Jinping has indicated positive progress in trade negotiations at the summit's outset. Global markets are closely monitoring the outcome, with cautious optimism for potential trade de-escalation.
title: Trump-Xi Summit Begins Amid Trade and Geopolitical Talks

details: Geopolitical tensions between the U.S. and Iran remain a significant concern for global markets. President Trump's recent rejection of Iran's ceasefire proposal has escalated hostilities, leading to increased volatility in oil prices and contributing to inflationary pressures. This ongoing uncertainty is prompting risk aversion among investors.
title: US-Iran Tensions Continue to Weigh on Markets
